title: Pandesal (Filipino Bread Rolls)
summary: Soft milk-and-egg rolls rolled in breadcrumbs and baked until pale golden.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt, add the milk, water and egg and knead 5 min, then work in the butter and knead 8 min more until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave about 1 h until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide into 16 pieces, roll each into a smooth ball, then roll it in the breadcrumbs.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Set on the lined tray about 2 cm apart, cover loosely and leave 45 min until puffy. Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 15-18 min until pale golden; the centre of a roll should read 88 °C.

tips: Use fine, dry breadcrumbs for an even coat.
Do not overbake; they should stay soft and pale.
Great with butter, cheese or jam.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
